snippet.title: Core Keeper - 1.2 Void & Voltage Update - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
BIG news, Explorers! We’re positively buzzing with excitement to let you know that Core Keeper is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on January 28th 2026, along with a brand-new major content update across all platforms!

Awaken as an explorer in a long-forgotten cavern teeming with treasures and secrets. Harvest relics and resources, craft advanced tools, build your base, and explore over 10 unique biomes in a dynamically evolving world just waiting to be unearthed. Cultivate crops, fish in mysterious waters, master recipes, hatch pets, raise cattle, drive vehicles, fight enemies, level up your skills, automate your bases, and defeat legendary Titans to unveil the power of the Core. 

Core Keeper – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition will be available to buy new or as a free upgrade to all existing owners on Nintendo Switch come January 28th 2026. The game is currently available on Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. 

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/corekeeper
Download on Steam: https://bit.ly/4oLWect
Download on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/core-keeper-switch/?srsltid=AfmBOor4p_xMZdno6Co-qc4dAEpqe6DRQpSSYxTGKtlMp-q6p7ulOoNP
Download on PlayStation 5 & 4: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/core-keeper/
Download on Xbox One and Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/core-keeper/9pkw4gmx4j8
